title: Arrange Shapes in Circle (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Arrange Shapes in Circle applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Arrange Shapes in Circle (BtnArrangeCircle) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnArrangeCircle places the selection as shape centers on the documented circle

requirements.text: BtnArrangeCircle applies Arrange Shapes in Pattern with the circle pattern and its documented defaults (radius = max(bounding-box width, height) / 2 around the selection bounding-box center, start angle 0, clockwise).

done.statement: The deterministic host-free scenario places the probe centers on the documented circle and passes; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews (office-only gate) remains until QA9-BtnArrangeCircle-002 has real-host evidence and review.

scenarios.expected: On a four-shape selection with bounding box 40,40..360,255 (center 200,147.5, radius 160), the circle pattern places the four shape centers exactly at (200,-12.5), (360,147.5), (200,307.5), (40,147.5) - clockwise from the top anchor with start angle 0 - and counterclockwise traversal or a start angle rotates the same path accordingly.

scenarios.title: BtnArrangeCircle deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: Real-host acceptance for the circle placement of selected shapes.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed BtnArrangeCircle arranges four fixed probes (bounding box 40,40..360,255) so that every probe shape center matches the hard-coded documented circle positions within 1 pt, the feature reports execution, all probes remain, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
